$comment: SkyLedger defaults. Every value here can be overridden by an environment variable named in its '_env' sibling. Secrets never go in this file; they live in .env.

ch4_gwp_by_reporting_year.$comment: GWP GHGRP uses to report CH4 as CO2e. AR4 = 25 up to RY2023; the April 2024 Table A-1 amendments (89 FR 31802) moved CH4 to AR5 = 28 from RY2024. RY2023 was verified against the published data (data/README.md).

attribution.$comment: PlumeReader and Skeptic geometry. GHGRP coordinates can sit hundreds of metres from the emitting equipment.

reconciliation.$comment: Implied annual range = (rate -/+ 1 sigma) x hours-per-year / 1000 x persistence (observed in the window .. 1.0).

vision.$comment: Advisory only: measured agreement with the wind on the 60-plume live run was 24/64 (38%) against ~33% for chance, so a disagreement never downgrades a case on its own.

providers.$comment: AI_PROVIDER picks where model calls go: nightshift (Meterless Nightshift, the default), nvidia (NVIDIA API directly, e.g. for hosting), none (deterministic fallbacks only). Model ids per role; each can be overridden by the env var named in *_env.
